properties.purpose: To conserve the landscape and biodiversity. Additionally, per the World Heritage designation, to conserve breeding sites of seabirds,
properties.restrictions:
The following activities are prohibited:
1.Dig minerals or collecting earth and stone (in the sea, limited to areas that are within a 1 km vicinity of a marine park);
2. Change the shape of the seabed (limited to areas that are within a 1 km vicinity of a marine park).
properties.allowed:
The following acts are permitted:
1. Actions carried out to execute park projects;
2. Certified acts performed as ecosystem maintenance and recovery projects;
3. Acts performed based on the landscape area protection agreement;
4. Ordinary management acts, light acts and other acts specified by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Environment;
5. Actions that were already undertaken when the area was expanded;
6. Actions taken as a necessary emergency measure in the event of an natural disaster.

The following acts requires notification to the Minister of the Environment:
1. New construction, renovation, extension of a structure whose scale exceeds the standard;
2. Mineral mining and earth and stone mining (sea area-in the sea area connected to one kilometer around the marine park area);
3. Change the shape of the land;
4. Change of the shape of the seabed (sea area-in the sea area connected to one kilometer around the marine park area)
properties.regulation_titles: Natural Park Act; Ogasawara National Park Management Plan
properties.regulation_urls: Natural Park Act|https://elaws.e-gov.go.jp/document?lawid=332AC0000000161; Ogasawara National Park Management Plan|http://www.env.go.jp/park/ogasawara/intro/files/plan_2.pdf
